senses.gloss: ज॑प mfn. ‘muttering, whispering’, see कर्णे-, कु-

ज॑प m. (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 61; oxyt. g. उञ्छादि) muttering prayers, repeating in a murmuring tone passages from scripture or charms or names of a deity, &c., muttered prayer or spell, AitBr. ii, 38; ŚBr. ii; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Nir. &c.
जपा f. (= जवा) the China rose, VarBṛS. xxviii, 14; BrahmaP. ii, 1, 7.
जाप m. (√ जप्) ‘whispering’, see कर्ण-
muttering prayers, L. a muttered prayer, L. (R. i, 51, 27 for जप; see also जाप्य).
जप—ता f. the state of one who mutters prayers, MBh. xiii, 1907 (जपताम् gen. pl. of जपत्, Sch.)
जप—परायण mfn. devoted to muttering prayers, W.
जप—माला f. a rosary used for counting muttered prayers.
जप—यज्ञ m. muttering prayers as a religious sacrifice, Mn. ii, 85 f.; Yājñ. i, 101; Bhag.; SkandaP.
जप—होम m. sg. and pl. muttering prayers as a religious offering, Mn. x, 111
xi, 34; MBh. xii, 3756; VarBṛS. vli, 51 and 58
(˚मक), Rudray. ii, 8, 1
जप—होम m. du. a muttered prayer and an offering, Śāktān. xii.
जपन n. muttering prayers, MBh. xii, 7157.
जापन n. for याप्˚, rejection, L.
dismissing, L.
completing, L.
जपनीय mfn. to be muttered, Mn. ii, 79, Sch.
जपित mfn. muttered, MBh. xii, 7248.
जपिन् mfn. muttering prayers, Yājñ. iii, 286.
जापिन् mfn. ifc. muttering, Yājñ. iii; Kathās.
जप्त mfn. = ˚पित, MBh. v, 7047; Naiṣ. xi, 26
whispered over, VarBṛS. iii, 72.
जप्त ˚प्तव्य, &c. See √ जप्.
जप्तव्य mfn. to be muttered, R. vii, 23, 4, 28; VarBṛS. vli, 72; BhP. iv, 24, 31.
ज॑प्य mfn. id., ŚBr. x; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Mn. xi, 143; VarBṛS.
ज॑प्य n. (once m. scil. मन्त्र, BhP. iv, 8, 53) a muttered prayer, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
जाप्य mfn. to be muttered, BhP. i, 19, 38
(fr. जाप) relating to a muttered prayer, MBh. xii, 7260
जाप्य n. a prayer to be muttered, muttering of prayers, MBh. xiii, 6232; R. i, 29, 32 (v.l. जाप), BhP. viii, 3, 1.
जप्य—कर्मन् n. = ˚पन, Āp. i, 15, 1.
जप्येश्वर-तीर्थ n. N. of a Tīrtha, VāsiṣṭhalP. iii.
जप्यक m. N. of a man, Rājat. vii, 495.
जपा—कुसुम-संनिभ m. ‘resembling the Japā -flower’, the plant हिङ्गूल, Npr.
जपाख्या f. = ˚पा, L.
जपापीड m. a garland of China roses, Mālatīm.
जपिल N. of a locality, W.
जापक mfn. muttering prayers or names of a deity (in comp.)
जापक m. a priest who mutters prayers, MBh. xii, 7153 f.; BhP. ix, 6, 10; Kathās. lxix; NṛsUp.; Hcat.
relating to a muttered prayer, MBh. xii, 7249 and 7336
जापक n. v.l. for जायक, L.
